Indian Badminton Pair Reaches China Masters Semifinals

Indian badminton doubles pair Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty have advanced to the semifinals of the China Masters tournament. They secured their spot by winning their quarterfinal match. However, their compatriot Kidambi Srikanth was eliminated from the competition in his respective match. The tournament is taking place in China.
